title: Patient Payment Plan Installment Posting, Autopay Retries and Payoff
content:
On a **Patient Payment Plan**, an installment may be paid through any of the tier's payment channels. Each installment payment is applied to the enrolled accounts in the tier's application order and posts to those accounts as a plan installment payment.

A failed autopay draft is retried once after the tier's retry period (the tier's retry count) and, if it fails again, the installment is treated as unpaid. A payment above the installment amount reduces the remaining schedule (the tier's overpayment application) and never pre-pays the next due date. A plan statement is sent the tier's statement lead time in calendar days before each due date. The plan is paid off when its balance reaches zero.

### Points of judgement

| Event | Effect |
|---|---|
| An autopay draft fails | it is retried once after the retry period |
| The retry also fails | the installment is treated as unpaid |
| The patient pays more than the installment | the remaining schedule is reduced; the next due date stays where it is |
| The plan balance reaches zero | the plan is paid off |

**Hypothetical.** An installment of 120.00 is paid as 300.00; the extra 180.00 reduces the remaining schedule, and the next installment still falls due on its own due date.
